big_case.notes: A Solicitor General application to stay a classwide injunction against the Bureau of Prisons' gender-dysphoria treatment policy, made under an Executive Order. It touches a certified nationwide class of about a thousand prisoners and continuing medical care. It is the third transgender-policy emergency application in two Terms. The legal question, APA record review of a prison medical policy plus PLRA remedy limits, is narrower than the Term's headline matters. The denial is a notable loss for the government on the emergency docket, but it decides no broad doctrine.
